own_solution.law: R = rho L/A. Constant volume gives A_final = A_initial/3, so R_final = 9 R_initial = 18 ohm. The dissipated power is P = V^2/R = 12^2/18 = 8 W.
assumptions: The circuit is evaluated in steady operation.
The separately powered lamp has no electrical connection to the wire's circuit.

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: The cell variants do not preserve the stated number and unit: TE42B and T4F86 omit the emf, whereas the other cell variants specify 7.5 V.

notes: The individual physics problems have determinate answers; the invalid verdict concerns the required variant construction. With an aiding cell in the present wire circuit, P = (12 + 7.5)^2/18 = 21.125 W. Cells used only in an earlier experiment do not affect the present circuit under the stated unchanged material conditions. The original length cancels because the initial resistance and stretch factor already determine the final resistance.
